crossRefs.note: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
“You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good…
and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

translations.web: I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
translations.bsb: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances—for the man who does these things will live by them.
translations.kjv: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live
translations.asv: And I gave them my statutes, and showed them mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live in them.
